Name: (FS) Persona Hairstyles
Author: Kuradjinou
Description:
Persona Hairstyles - 2.0.0


[b]﻿INSTALLATION:[/b]
[spoiler]
    -Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] if you haven't already.
    (It will also require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url].)

    -Download the mod.

    -Unzip the PersonaHairstyles_200 zip file.
   
    -Place the unzipped folder ( [FS] PersonaHairstyles ) into the Mods folder (e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)

    -Start the game using SMAPI (StardewModdingAPI.exe in the Stardew Valley folder).

    -You should now be able to select new hairstyles, hats, and shirts from the Persona characters using the Hand Mirror tool from Fashion Sense.[/spoiler]



Last functionality test was on Stardew Valley v1.6.15.
If you have any troubles with the mod, leave a comment and I'll try to get back to you when I can.
-Kuradjinou
